Quinoa and Vegetables
By: Bianca Avelino-...
Published: Monday, April 19, 2010 - 4:56pm

Ingredients




1 cup uncooked quinoa
1 bell pepper, diced
1 small cucumber, diced
2 tablespoons rice vinegar
1 tablespoon olive oil
Salt & pepper to taste.

Preparation

1 Bring 2 cups of water to a boil in a medium saucepan. 2 Add quinoa and simmer for 14-18 minutes or until fluffy. 3 Drain. 4 In a medium bowl, mix quinoa and all ingredients together. 5 Serve warm.

About


Here's a healthy vegetarian recipe using a much underrated grain, quinoa.
